evidenceBoundary: Repository-declared profiles and static contract validation only; live PsyCoder Studio deployment, end-to-end integration, and target-machine runtime require separate evidence.
standalonePolicy: See STANDALONE.md; these deployment flags do not block standalone candidate generation

limitations: This profile implements the classic color-word Stroop task only.
Semantic, emotional, numerical, bilingual, and other Stroop-family designs require their own confirmed semantics and must not inherit this profile.
Text and blank windows only
One response window per trial
RT onset must be self
Generated factorial trial sources only
Canonical keys: one lowercase alphanumeric, space, or enter
Color fields: black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, gray, or grey
Window and global scored-response rules must agree
